incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED 3241234567 severity=P1 — Elevated 5xx/timeouts observed on /v1/generate, auto-paging @ashley
ashley (oncall): ACK, I'm looking. Dashboards show spike in 502/504 and gateway timeouts. High CPU on kv-shard-7 and p99 backend latency rising.
samir (eng-runtime): Looking at kv-proxy metrics — huge read-amplification and prefix cache miss ratio jumped ~12x across several hot prefixes.
lee (eng-sre): Confirmed correlation: prefix cache misses -> read fanout -> backend saturation -> 5xx cascade. Seeing gateway 502s from proxy timeouts.
nisha (support): Two customers reported errors simultaneously (AcmeCorp, PaperTrail). CS already triaging.
maria (product): Can we get customer impact numbers? Rough ETA for mitigation?
ashley (oncall): Quick options: 1) disable prefetch for prefix cache, 2) bypass cache for hot prefixes, 3) throttle read fanout, 4) failover traffic to fallback routing. Going to coordinate.
samir (eng-runtime): I can flip a runtime flag to bypass caching for the top hot prefix (m/abc123) in ~30s. Also can add exponential backoff on kv retries.
lee (eng-sre): I'll spin up extra kv-proxy instances, increase connection pool to healthy backends, and restrict shard rebalancer activity.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting config change: runtime/inference-proxy -> bump replicas + apply transient bypass flag (initiated by samir)
ashley (oncall): Posting to status page now: "We are investigating elevated errors on hosted API endpoints. Mitigation in progress; updates every 15 minutes."
jacob (customer-success): Notified affected customers with suggested workarounds: retry with backoff and use dedicated endpoint where available. Sending follow-up note.
samir (eng-runtime): Pushing bypass flag: /configs/runtime/bypass_hot_prefix=true -> rolling to prod
samir (eng-runtime): Recent logs highlight the overload:
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:11Z] kv-proxy: prefix='m/abc123' misses=1200 -> routing direct to backend
[2026-03-15T02:14:12Z] kv-proxy: read-amplification=18x, backend-latency=420ms
[2026-03-15T02:14:13Z] kv-backend: conn_pool_wait=220ms errors=45
```
lee (eng-sre): After scale-up and bypass, backend p99 latency down from ~800ms to ~260ms. 502 rate dropping.
ashley (oncall): Observed ~65% reduction in 5xx in last 2 minutes. Still elevated vs baseline; continuing to monitor.
nisha (support): Any concerns about consistency with bypass enabled? CS: customers prefer brief outage over inconsistent reads.
samir (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: bloom-filter/index compaction regression. Overnight compaction swapped a corrupt bloom filter causing many false negatives -> massive read fanout.
maria (product): Which compaction rollout triggered this? We need the CI job ID.
samir (eng-runtime): Compaction job KV-COMP-20260314-2350 ran across shardset-7. Telemetry shows filter swap at 23:50 UTC.
ashley (oncall): Rolling back compaction isn't trivial live. Mitigation plan: pause compaction queue, keep bypass active, and prepare a safety-patched compaction with CRC checks.
lee (eng-sre): Opening rollback job to pause compaction processes across shards. Also applying connection limits to prevent cascading failure.
samir (eng-runtime): Preparing hotfix: add CRC before bloom filter swap and a canary validation pass. Will deploy to canary first.
ops-bot: pagerduty-bot: ashley acknowledged the page. samir and lee assigned as follow-up owners.
ashley (oncall): Monitoring: 5xx rate now 1.6% (baseline ~0.2%) down from peak 6.8%. P95 latency trending toward normal.
maria (product): Customer impact summary: two enterprise customers experienced ~30% request failures for a window between 02:10–02:28 UTC. Need credit/exec summary.
jacob (customer-success): Preparing outreach templates and coordinating with finance for credits. Will attach logs and timeline.
samir (eng-runtime): Hotfix deployed to canary — CRC guard prevents stale bloom swap on validation fail. If canary is stable for 10m push to prod.
lee (eng-sre): Creating handoff ticket for next shift with explicit runbook: disable prefetch, bypass hot prefixes, scale kv-proxy, monitor read-amplification, pause compaction. Ticket INC-3241234 created.
nisha (support): Adding customer cases to INC-3241234 and tagging for follow-up.
samir (eng-runtime): Postmortem owners assigned: samir (primary), lee (secondary). Deliverables: timeline, root cause analysis, improved compaction safety checks, and a regression test for bloom-filter swaps.
ashley (oncall): We'll unpage in 40m if stable. Thanks team — great coordination :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED 3241234567 — mitigation_summary="bypass + scale-up + hotfix canary; postmortem pending" closed_by=ashley
maria (product): Adding postmortem to sprint; will prepare exec summary and customer impact slide.
jacob (customer-success): Final: both customers accepted the temporary workaround and want ETA for permanent fix. Scheduling sync with engineering.
ashley (oncall): Logging metrics snapshot and closing handoff. Follow-up items: postmortem doc, compaction safety rollout, customer outreach.
